item.title: [github_trending] alibaba/open-code-review
item.description: Alibaba has open-sourced OpenCodeReview, a Go code-review tool that combines deterministic pipelines with an LLM agent to produce precise line-level comments, supported by a built-in multi-language ruleset covering issues such as NPEs and thread safety. It is described as battle-tested at Alibaba's scale, making it worth a look for teams wiring automated review into CI without trusting an LLM for every judgement.

item.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published a long essay urging frontier labs to slow the pace of capability progress so safety evaluation and governance can catch up, then gave his first interview since, arguing AI cannot be stopped but must slow down. The essay cites AI agents that could act as a "cluster" in unauthorized cyberattacks and an Anthropic threat report on attempted misuse of Claude for weapons development; Elon Musk and Sam Altman both publicly agreed.

item.title: [infoq] Token账单异常，可能不只是成本失控
item.description: Akamai Greater China VP Zhang Ke argues that abnormal token consumption is not just a cost problem but a security signal: Denial of Wallet attacks inflate bills with floods of requests, and agentic crawlers trigger multi-turn inference that ordinary traffic never caused. He cites Akamai's 2026 AI Inference report, in which 77% of surveyed enterprises lacked consistent per-token cost metrics, and calls for moving that visibility into an AI gateway for real-time control.

item.title: [github_trending] debpalash/VoiceStudio

item.description: colibri is a pure-C, dependency-free inference engine that treats disk, RAM and VRAM as one memory hierarchy and streams experts from disk, letting frontier MoE models of 744B to 2.8T parameters run on consumer or heterogeneous hardware. Nine model families are supported today, including GLM, Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4. It targets developers who want to serve very large MoE models on machines they already own.

item.description: OpenAI deliberately took on technical debt by building Habitat, its core online storage platform, as a Python service, betting that Codex and GPT would eventually make a rewrite cheap. In the second quarter of this year, two engineers rewrote it in Rust with Codex and GPT-5.5; the Rust version now handles 95% of production requests with 6x better CPU efficiency, 15x better memory efficiency, and lower average and tail latency.

item.title: [infoq] HTTP 新增 QUERY 方法：有人叫好，也有人质疑“这不就是 GET？”
item.description: In June 2026 the IETF published RFC 10008, adding QUERY as a new HTTP method: the first new standard verb since PATCH in 2010, authored by Julian Reschke, James Snell and Mike Bishop. QUERY carries a request body like POST while keeping the safe, idempotent and cacheable semantics of a read, and servers can advertise support with Accept-Query. It speaks directly to the long-running search-API debate over URL length limits and filter leakage into logs.

The author argues the reasons need to be understood before deciding what to do about it.
